name: docs-audit
description: Full documentation quality audit, read-only. One pinned Sonnet auditor runs any of 17 checks — content types, structure, style, audience, navigation, SEO, accessibility, i18n, media, maintenance, trust, pricing consistency, competitor gap, rank recovery, title rewriting, content gaps, AI retrieval — and returns machine-readable JSON findings. Never edits a doc page; that is docs-sync's or docs-create's job.
